answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable bond that grows with account creation rate, like vines checked on a trellis: one identity pays once, but a thousand Sybils pay a thousand bonds. A periodic pulse audit randomly challenges agents to prove live work; failed or duplicate responders are slashed. On a shared terrace of verifiable history, splitting into fakes multiplies capital at risk, not influence, so attack cost scales linearly while honest cost stays flat.
